verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Sprinto publishes an llms.txt index at docs.sprinto.com (HTTP 200) that lists descriptions of its doc pages. They also confirm markdown versions of doc pages (.md endpoints) that point back to llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. The goSprinto compliance-skills repo adds installable agent skills. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-usage guidance, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404).
